retirement_gates.title: SCI coverage
retirement_gates.description: At least 95% of students with an active study plan have an active Student Curriculum Instance.

retirement_gates.title: Published curriculum coverage
retirement_gates.description: Every subject code with a CKG edition has ≥1 published edition (100% published curriculum coverage).

retirement_gates.title: Educational Decision coverage
retirement_gates.description: At least 90% of active SCIs have ≥1 persisted EI-007 Educational Decision.

retirement_gates.title: Runtime A fallback rate
retirement_gates.description: Process-scoped RIS fallback rate is at most 5% of educational surface requests.

retirement_gates.title: Experience Model generation rate
retirement_gates.description: At least 95% of RIS requests produce EX-001 Experience Models (Educational Intelligence path).

retirement_gates.title: Integration test pass requirement
retirement_gates.description: Preferred-authority, fallback telemetry, and no-bypass verification suites must pass (enforced by CI / local pytest).

retirement_gates.title: No active Runtime A recommendation authority
retirement_gates.description: Inventory contains no entries that both block retirement and remain status=active under runtime_a_recommendation / runtime_a_planning / compatibility_control categories.
